outputs.explanation: Panel A shows an H&E micrograph alongside spatial transcriptomic heatmap plots (Log2 expression color scale) for Tmprss11b, Krt13, and Krt6a. Heatmaps do not require overlaid individual data points.
Panel B consists solely of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs; it contains no plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel C is a scatter/dot plot showing each patient sample's TMPRSS11B expression value as an individual point (LUAD n=512, LUSC n=500), with median and 95% CI overlaid. Individual data points are the data itself and are fully displayed.
Panel D is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of TMPRSS11B expression across four conditions, with individual data points (n=3 per group) overlaid as dots on each bar.
